name: node-express-mongo-playground
description: Learning project: a production-style Node.js + Express + MongoDB + React HR app

scripts.generate:client: npm run openapi:write && npm run generate --workspace @hr/api-client
scripts.check:client: npm run generate:client && git diff --exit-code -- openapi.json packages/api-client/src/generated && test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- openapi.json packages/api-client/src/generated)"
